title: microglia and myeloid cells multiplexed scRNA-seq rep2, HTO
ext: Multiplexed single-cell sequencing with cell hashing was performed following previously published protocol (30567574). In brief, each type of cells were first blocked with Human TruStain FcX (BioLegend Catalog# 422302) in cell staining buffer (BioLegend Catalog# 420201) for 10 minutes on ice, followed by staining with an individual TotalSeq-A anti-human Hashtag for 45 minutes on ice. Cells were washed three times, resuspended in PBS with 0.04% bovine serum albumin, and counted with Countess II Automated Cell Counter (Thermo Fisher Scientific). 1.25 x 10^5 cells were pooled from each group to create a pool of 1x10^6 cells with an average viability of 85%. Pooled cells were then filtered through a 40 Î¼m filter, counted, and diluted to a final concentration of 730 cells/Î¼L.,Single cell suspension containing 6.4x105 cells were loaded into 10X Chromium Controller following manufacturerâs user guide (Document CG000185 Rev B) using 2 lanes of Chromium Single Cell 3â Reagent Kits v3. Single cell gene expression and hashtag barcode libraries were constructed following the manufacturerâs user guide (Document CG000185 Rev B). Final libraries were sequenced on Illumina NovaSeq 6000 sequencer using NovaSeq 6000 S4 Reagent Kit v1 to get a total of 2x109 reads.

title: Monocyte-derived M1 macrophages (D1) [AB-LIB]
ext: Single-cell transcriptomics libraries were generated via the Chromium Controller and the Single Cell 3â² Reagent Kit v3 (10x Genomics) according to the manufacturerâs instructions. Briefly, ~8,700 cells per sample were loaded onto a B Chip, aiming to capture 5,000 cells, with an expected 4.6% doublet rate. The Chromium Controller ran for droplet generation and reverse transcription was performed in the droplets.,80 ng of cDNA were used for the gene expression library preparation. Samples were prepared according to the 10X Genomicsâ protocol, except for an additional 1 x SPRISelect Beads (Beckman Coulter, Brea, CA) to ensure full removal of primer and adaptor dimers prior to the final elution for gene expression libraries. Libraries were quantitatively and qualitatively assessed using the Qubit 4 Fluorometer (ThermoFisher) and the Fragment Analyzer (Agilent) respectively. Gene expression libraries were 440bp in average length. Libraries were normalized, pooled and sequenced on an Illumina HiSeq 4000.

title: Pheripheral blood cells, healthy control, CITE- seq
ext: Peripheral white blood cells (pWBCs) were gathered as below. Blood samples were collected in heparin blood collection tubes, and red blodd cells were removed usinig Hetasep (STEMCELL Technologies).pWBCs were enriched by density gradient centrifugation at 90 x g for 4 minutes at room temperature.,pWBCs were labeled by TotalSeq-B Human TBNK Cocktail (BioLegend).Library was performed according to the manufacterâs instructions (Chromium Single Cell 3' Reagent Kits v3.1, 10x Genomics) for scRNA-seq and CITE-seq. Briefly, pWBC were resuspended in the master mix and loaded together with partitioning oil and gel beads into the chip to generate the gel bead-in-emulsion (GEM). The poly-A RNA from the cell lysate contained in every single GEM was retrotranscripted to cDNA, which contains an Ilumina R1 primer sequence, Unique Molecular Identifier (UMI) and the 10x Barcode. The pooled barcoded cDNA was then cleaned up with Silane DynaBeads, amplified by PCR and the apropiated sized fragments were selected with SPRI select reagent for subsequent library construction. During the library construction Ilumina R2 primer sequence, paired-end constructs with P5 and P7 sequences and a sample index were added.

title: Pool 1, HTO derived cDNA
ext: Nuclei from fresh frozen tissues were isolated following the Nuclei Pure Prep nuclei isolation kit (Sigma-Aldrich, Catalog ID: NUC201) with some modifications. To summarize, ~10mg of tissue were washed with PBS to remove extraneous OCT the samples were frozen in. The tissue was homogenized with both wide and narrow pestles submerged in 2.5mL of the lysis buffer in a Dounce homogenizer. The lysate mixed with 4.5mL 1.8M sucrose cushion were gently layered on top of the 2.5mL of 1.8M sucrose cushion in Beckman ultracentrifuge tubes. Samples were centrifuged for 45 min at 13,000 RPM at 4Â°C in an ultracentrifuge. Samples were multiplexed with lipid-tagged oligonucleotides following the MULTI-seq protocol19. Nuclei were resuspended in 1% BSA PBS and filtered with 70um and 40um Flowmi filters.,Library was performed according to the manufacterâs instructions (single cell 3â protocol, 10x Genomics). Cellular mRNA and hashtag oligonucleotides were reverse-transcribed and indexed with a shared cellular barcode. Indexed cDNAs were then pooled and amplified by PCR according to the Chromium Single Cell 3â protocol (10x Genomics) and with specific primers amplifying the HTO-derived tags.

title: UPN23/29 SC_m, scRNAseq [HTO_R306-309]
ext: Human Peripheral Blood Mononuclear Cells (PBMCs) used in this study are obtained after consent from AML patients. PBMCs were isolated from peripheral blood after centrifugation to separate them from plasma and other peripheral blood components using ficoll-Hystopaque density gradient centrifugation. After the separation of PBMCs from whole blood, the cells were preserved using Cryopreservation that consists of freezing the cells at -80Â°C or in liquid nitrogen at -195.79Â°C for a long period. For this purpose, PBMCs were stored in a freezing medium (90% FBS and 10% DMSO). Cryopreserved cells in liquid nitrogen were thawed at 37Â°C. Cells were rinsed with RPMI 1640 medium to remove the DMSO-containing freezing medium. To enrich the samples with live cells, dead cells were removed using the Dead Cell Removal Kit. Before starting cell labeling, a 50-Î¼L aliquot containing 1,000,000 cells suspended in a Cell Staining Buffer (CSB) with >95% viability was prepared for each sample. The antibodies used for labeling were TotalSeq -A0251(HTO1) and -A0252 (HTO2) antibody-oligo (Biolegend). Next, we proceeded to the labeling step. For this, 1Î¼g HTO is added to each cell suspension. The two labeled samples are then incubated for 30 minutes at 4Â°C. The cells then undergo 3 successive washes with 3.5 mL of CSB and centrifugation at 400 g for 5 minutes at 5Â°C. Finally, the cells are resuspended at a concentration of 1.106 cells/mL in PBS.,Library was performed according to the manufacterâs instructions (single cell 3â v2 protocol, 10x Genomics). Briefly, PBMCs labeled with/without HTOs were resuspended in the master mix and loaded together with partitioning oil and gel beads into the chip to generate the gel bead-in-emulsion (GEM). The poly-A RNA from the cell lysate contained in every single GEM was retrotranscripted to cDNA, which contains an Ilumina R1 primer sequence, Unique Molecular Identifier (UMI) and the 10x Barcode. The pooled barcoded cDNA was then cleaned up with Silane DynaBeads, amplified by PCR and the apropiated sized fragments were selected with SPRIselect reagent for subsequent library construction. During the library construction Ilumina R2 primer sequence, paired-end constructs with P5 and P7 sequences and a sample index were added.

title: Retinal organoids, DD230, RUN2, HTO
ext: Retinal organoids were dissociated using an adapted protocol from the Papain Dissociation kit (Worthington, I-LK 03150). In short, single retinal organoids were selected and cut into small pieces to remove excess RPE or non-neural tissue as much as possible, and placed on a 48 well plate with 500Âµl dissociation solution (20 units/ml papain and 0.005% DNase). These were incubated for 30 minutes on a shaker in the incubator, then the organoids were triturated using a 1mL pipettor to dissociate the tissue. The plate was placed back for 15-20 minutes on the shaker in the incubator, then again triturated, this was repeated until a single cell suspension was obtained. 500Âµl albumin ovomucoid protease inhibitor solution was added to the single cell suspension, centrifuged at 300x g for 5min. Supernatant was removed, pellet resuspend in PBS and filtered through 40um cell strainer (Pluristrainer; SKU 43-10040-50). Filtered single cell suspension was centrifuged at 300x g for 5min at 4ËC and resuspend in 100Âµl staining buffer (2%BSA/0.01%Tween, PBS) with 10Âµl Fc Blocking reagent (FcX, BioLegend) for 10 minutes on ice. 0.5Âµg of unique Cell Hashing antibodies were added and incubated for 20 minutes on ice. Stained cells were washed 3 times with 1mL staining buffer; spin at 4 ËC for 5 minutes at 350g. Stained single cell suspensions were counted for cell concentration and cell viability (TC20, Bio-rad). Typically, all single cell suspensions had a 70% or higher cell viability. Stained cells were pooled and re-count until desired concentration for single cell sequencing (cell viability at least 80%). Every sequencing round contained 14 hashed retinal organoid samples, the goal was to capture a total of approximately 30.000 cells per pool.,Library was performed according to the manufacterâs instructions (single cell 3â v3 protocol, 10x Genomics)

title: Patient 9 HSPCs, ADT-derived cDNA
ext: We performed SC CITEseq sequencing on unsorted mononuclear cells from 12 patients using a pre-templated instant partitions (PIPs) sequencing platform.,Briefly, cryopreserved cells were thawed, normalized combined in a 1:10 ratio with barcoded PIPs, which were then vortexed and centrifuged into emulsifications. Emulsions were thermocycled, broken, mixed, washed, and pelleted. Reverse transcription was performed, and cDNA synthesis completed. After whole transcriptome amplification, PIPs were column filtered and purified with Ampure XP. Libraries were generated from WTA amplified material using the Nextera XT DNA Library Preparation Kit with a custom primer (PIPs_P5library) and standard Nextera P7 indexing primers (N70x). Libraries were pooled and sequenced using an Illumina NextSeq 2000.

title: CheRNASeq_multiH1sh_Untreated_r1
ext: Chromatin-enriched RNA (CheRNA) fraction was extracted. Briefly, 40x106 T47D cells were lysed in 800 ÂµL ice-cold Lysis Buffer A (10 mM Tris pH 7.5, 0.1% NP-40, 150 mM NaCl) for 5 min on ice. A sucrose cushion (24% sucrose in lysis buffer A) was used to collect nuclei upon centrifugation (200g, 4ÂºC,10min). Pellet was washed with pre-chilled PBS + 1mM EDTA, and resuspended in 500ÂµL ice-cold Glycerol Buffer (20 mM Tris pH 7.9, 75 mM NaCl, 0.5 mM EDTA, 0.85 mM DTT, 0.125 mM PMSF, 50% glycerol). Nuclei were lysed by adding ice-cold Lysis Buffer B (10 mM HEPES pH 7.6, 1mM DTT, 7.5 mM MgCl2, 0.2 mM EDTA, 0.3M NaCl, 1M urea, 1% NP-40) and kept on ice for 10 min, with periodic vortex shaking. Pellet containing chromatin was obtained by centrifugation (14000g, 4ÂºC,2 min), washed twice with pre-chilled PBS+1mM EDTA, and finally resuspended in 100 ÂµL PBS. Che-RNA were purified using TRIZOL reagent (Invitrogen), following the manufacturerâs instructions.,Strand-Specific Transcriptome Library Construction Protocol (DNBSEQ). According to the manufacturerâs instructions, the first step involves the removal of ribosomal RNA (rRNA) using target-specific oligos and RNase H reagents to deplete both cytoplasmic (5S rRNA, 5.8S rRNA, 18S rRNA, and 28S rRNA) and mitochondrial ribosomal RNA (12S rRNA and 16S rRNA) from total RNA preparations. Following SPRI beads purification, the RNA is fragmented into small pieces using divalent cations under elevated temperature. The cleaved RNA fragments are copied into first-strand cDNA using reverse transcriptase and random primers, followed by second-strand cDNA synthesis using DNA Polymerase I and RNase H. This process removes the RNA template and synthesizes a replacement strand, incorporating dUTP in place of dTTP to generate ds cDNA. These cDNA fragments then have the addition of a single 'A' base and subsequent ligation of the adapter. After UDG treatment, the incorporation of dUTP quenches the second strand during amplification. The products are enriched with PCR to create the final cDNA library. The librariesâ quality and quantity were assessed in two methods: check the distribution of the fragment size using the Agilent 2100 bioanalyzer and quantify the library using real-time quantitative PCR (QPCR) (TaqMan Probe). The qualified libraries were sequenced pair end on the BGISEQ-500/ MGISEQ-2000 System (BGI-Shenzhen, China).

title: HTO_Hashtag_R342_DMSO, scRNAseq
ext: Human Peripheral Blood Mononuclear Cells (PBMCs) used in this study are obtained after consent from AML patients. PBMCs were isolated from peripheral blood after centrifugation to separate them from plasma and other peripheral blood components using ficoll-Hystopaque density gradient centrifugation. After the separation of PBMCs from whole blood, the cells were preserved using : Cryopreservation that consists of freezing the cells at -80Â°C or in liquid nitrogen at -195.79Â°C for a long period using freezing medium (90% FBS and 10% DMSO), the second method to preserve the cell is the cell fixation using the pre-chiled methanol before storage at -80Â°C . . Cryopreserved cells in liquid nitrogen were thawed at 37Â°C. Cells were rinsed with RPMI 1640 medium to remove the DMSO-containing freezing medium. To enrich the samples with live cells, dead cells were removed using the Dead Cell Removal Kit. Before starting cell labeling, a 50-Î¼L aliquot containing 1,000,000 cells suspended in a Cell Staining Buffer (CSB) with >95% viability was prepared for each sample. The antibodies used for labeling were TotalSeq -A0251(HTO1) and -A0252 (HTO2) antibody-oligo (Biolegend). Next, we proceeded to the labeling step. For this, 1Î¼g HTO is added to each cell suspension. The two labeled samples are then incubated for 30 minutes at 4Â°C. The cells then undergo 3 successive washes with 3.5 mL of CSB and centrifugation at 400 g for 5 minutes at 5Â°C. Finally, the cells are resuspended at a concentration of 1.106 cells/mL in PBS. To rehydrate methanol-fixed PBMCs, the cells were thawed from -80Â°C to 4Â°C and incubated for 5 minutes. After incubation, the cells were centrifuged at 1000 g for 5 minutes, and the methanol was carefully removed. The resulting cell pellet was then resuspended in a rehydration buffer containing 3x SSC buffer, 0.04% BSA, 1mM DTT, and 0.2 U/Âµl RNase inhibitor. Finally, the cell concentration was determined by counting the cells using the LUNA FL cell counter. This rehydration process allows for the preparation of viable and well-dispersed PBMCs for downstream analyses.,Library was performed according to the manufacterâs instructions Chromium Next Gem Single Cell 3' Reagent Kits v3.1 with Feature Barcoding technology for Cell Surface Protein (for the cryoconserved cells), and and the user guide single cell 3â v3 protocol, 10x Genomics (for fixed cells). Briefly, PBMCs labeled with/without HTOs were resuspended in the master mix and loaded together with partitioning oil and gel beads into the chip to generate the gel bead-in-emulsion (GEM). The poly-A RNA from the cell lysate contained in every single GEM was retrotranscripted to cDNA, which contains an Ilumina R1 primer sequence, Unique Molecular Identifier (UMI) and the 10x Barcode. The pooled barcoded cDNA was then cleaned up with Silane DynaBeads, amplified by PCR and the apropiated sized fragments were selected with SPRIselect reagent for subsequent library construction. During the library construction Ilumina R2 primer sequence, paired-end constructs with P5 and P7 sequences and a sample index were added.

title: ESI017 WT+1G4TCR SP8 (A02BI Stroma), replicate 1, VDJ scRNA-seq
ext: Isolation of ATO-derived SP8: ATOs were harvested by adding MACS buffer (PBS, 0.5% bovine serum albumin, 2mM EDTA) to each filter, briefly disaggregating the ATO by pipetting with a 1mL âP1000â pipette, and then passed through a 50Âµm nylon strainer; SP8 T cells were harvested after 6 Weeks of T cell differentiation, and DP precursors were harvested after 3 Weeks. For bulk-scale collection of ATOs, aggregates were harvested in a similar fashion; however, up to 150 aggregates were collected in a well filled with MACS buffer and then transferred onto a 50Âµm nylon filter, where aggregates were physically dissociated on top of the filter using the back end of a sterile 1mL syringe. After dissociation, the filter was washed with MACS buffer, and cell mixtures were centrifuged at 300 x g for 5m at 4C in a swinging bucket centrifuge.,Single cell RNA library preparation and sequencing: ATO-derived T cells were isolated as described above and then FACS-sorted for ATO-derived SP8 T cells from WT (mCD29-CD45+CD8a+CD4-) and 1G4 TCR-transduced (mCD29-mTagBFP2+CD45+CD8a+CD4-) PSCs ATOs into PBS + 0.04% bovine serum albumin. For ESI017 WT PSCs differentiated in MS5-hDLL4 stroma ATOs, SP8 and CD45+ fractions were both collected. Cells were counted and resuspended at a concentration of ~1000 cells/ÂµL and provided to the Technology Center for Genomics and Bioinformatics (TCGB) core for unique molecular identifier (UMI) tagging and generation of gene expression (GEX) and human TCR repertoire (VDJ) libraries using the 10X Chromium Next GEM Single Cell V(D)J Reagent Kit v1.1 (10X Genomics, Pleasanton, CA). Similarly, peripheral blood (PB) SP8s were FACS-isolated (CD45+CD8A+CD8B+CD4-TCRab+CD3+) from PB mononuclear cells obtained from healthy donors, and provided to the TCGB core for UMI tagging and library generation. Fully constructed libraries for all samples were run in one S4 flowcell on the Illumina Novaseq Platform.,5' Gene Expression (GEX), VDJ, and Feature Barcoding libraries were constructed according to the manufacturer's instructions (Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 5' Reagent Kits v2, 10X Genomics).

title: Tube-K562-1
ext: Single cells were isolated with the Digital microfluidics chip. By incorporating 2'-deoxy-5-methylcytidine 5'-triphosphate (5-methyl dCTP) during reverse transcription and cDNA amplification, the resulting library of RNA and gDNA sequencing reads exhibit drastically different methylation patterns. Single-cell DNA methylation and gene expression information were obtained simultaneously, without the need to physically separate DNA and RNA.,After single-cell isolation, droplets of lysis buffer are introduced to lyse the cells. The lysates are then subjected to RT and cDNA amplification using 5â-methyl-dCTP instead of dCTP, so that all cytosines in the synthesized cDNA are methylcytosines, while the genomic DNA remains unchanged during the process. Subsequently, both the cDNA and gDNA undergo bisulfite conversion concurrently, during which normal cytosines are converted to uracil, while methylated cytosines remain unchanged. Consequently, fully cytosine-methylated cDNA produced from RNA remains unaffected by the C-U transition. In contrast, less than 10% of mammalian genomic cytosines are endogenously methylated, resulting in a substantial conversion of gDNA cytosines to uracil, which will be identified as thymine in sequencing. After scBS-seq-based library construction, the DNA reads are distinguished from RNA reads based on the methylated cytosine density in reads, and thus both DNA methylation and gene expression information are obtained from a single-cell library.,smart-seq2 and scBS

title: Samples 4-5, PBMC, post treatment, Adalimumab non-responder (CMO)
ext: Peripheral venous blood was collected into K2EDTA tubes (Vacutainer BD, Franklin Lakes, NJ, USA). The PBMCs were isolated using density gradient centrifugation with Lympholyte H Cell Separation Medium (Cedarlane, Burlington, ON, Canada) and SepMate 50 centrifuge tubes (StemCells Technologies, Vancouver, BC, Canada). The remaining platelets and erythrocytes were removed using the low-speed centrifugation and red blood cell lysis, respectively. The isolated PBMCs were stored in liquid nitrogen at a density of 1-10E6 cells/mL. A combination of 10% dimethyl sulfoxide (Sigma-Aldrich, Bur-lington, MA, USA) and 40% heat-inactivated fetal bovine serum (Gibco, ThermoFisher Scientific, Waltham, MA, USA) was used as the cryopreservation medium. The cell concentration was determined using the CytoSmart automated cell counter (Corning Inc., Corning, NY, USA). To perform scRNA-seq the 10X Chromium System (10X Genomics, Pleasanton, CA, USA) was used. First, the cryopreserved PBMCs were thawed and washed in Dulbecco's Phosphate-Buffered Saline supplemented with 5% FBS to remove the cryopreservation medium. The quality of the cell samples was confirmed using the trypan blue exclusion and viability of all samples was >90%. 2E6 cells per sample were used for the library preparation.,Samples 001 and 002 were processed as single reactions using Chromium Next Gem Single Cell 3' Kit v3.1 (PN-1000269), Chromium Next GEM Chip G Single Cell Kit (PN-1000127), and Dual Index Kit TT Set A (PN-1000215; all 10X Genomics) according to the manufacturerâs instructions (CG000315 Rev E). Other samples were processed as multiplexed reactions, with three samples per reaction, using Chromium Next Gem Single Cell 3' Kit v3.1 (PN-1000269), 3â Feature Barcode Kit (PN-1000262), Dual Index Kit TT Set A (PN-1000215) and Dual Index Kit NN Set A (PN-1000243; all 10X Genomics). For the multiplexed samples, the cells were first CMO labelled using 3âCellPlex Kit Set A (PN-1000261, 10X Genomics) according to the manufacturerâs instructions (CG000391 Rev B). All samples were loaded onto the Chromium Controller Instrument (10X Ge-nomics) to generate gel bead-in-emulsions (GEM). Next, complementary DNA (cDNA) libraries were constructed. GEMâreverse transcription (RT) was performed in a C1000 deepwell block thermocycler (BioRad, Hercules, CA, USA). The cDNA was purified using Dynabeads MyOne Silane Beads (Thermo Fisher Scientific) and amplified following the recommendations in the 10X Genomics protocol CG000315 Rev E, for single reaction samples, and protocol CG000388 Rev C, for multiplex reaction samples. The product was subsequently purified using the SPRIselect Reagent Kit (B23318, Beckman Coulter, Brea, CA, USA,). Next, 3â Gene Expression Libraries were constructed using the Chromium Single-Cell 3â² Library Construction Kit (PN-1000196). For the multiplexed samples Cell Multiplexing Libraries were additionally generated using Dual Index Kit NN Set A (PN-1000243) and 3âFeature Barcode Kit (PN-1000262). Library quality control was performed using the Agilent Bioanalyzer 2100 and using High Sensitivity DNA Kit (Agilent, Santa Clara, CA, USA). The prepared libraries were sequenced with Illumina NovaSeq pair-end 150bp at GENEWIZ (GENEWIZ Germany GmbH, Leipzig, Germany) with an average sequencing depth of >100 million reads per library yielding approximate average of 28,600 reads per cell.
